prompt: Write a function `fib(n)` that returns the nth Fibonacci number, where fib(0) == 0 and fib(1) == 1. Handle non-negative integers `n`.

tests.test_base_cases:
assert fib(0) == 0
assert fib(1) == 1
assert fib(2) == 1
tests.test_medium:
assert fib(10) == 55
assert fib(15) == 610
assert fib(20) == 6765
